name: bitcoin_node_module
description: The Bitcoin wallet's sources per network: Kyoto peers, Electrum servers, and your node (in Logos or over RPC). Tor per source through one proxy, the Tor that comes with Logos (tor_module) by default, a route table per role, curated peer lists, and address-free health probes. Fail-closed: a source routed through Tor never falls back to a direct connection.
author: Logos Core Team
